• Reporting date: 2026-10-27 (KST) · run id 2026-10-27-event · mode event (incremental) · previous run 2026-10-26-event (run no. 4) · previous monthly run 2026-10 (Source: run information injected by the workflow · state.run)

  • Reference price: $146.90 — close on 2026-10-26 (Mon), volume 103.9 million shares. Down 0.4% from the previous run's reference price of $147.49 (10/23) (formula: 146.90 ÷ 147.49 − 1) (stockanalysis daily history, accessed 2026-10-27: latest row 10/26)
  • Scope: Only what T5 touches — Axis D (financials), milestone D-2027-1, definition additional_financing, rule R3 and proposed new rules ② and ③, trigger T5. T4 (Amazon Leo) keeps its checkpoint of 12/01. A full recalculation of PHASE 1–4 is not performed (Source: state.triggers_next_12m · prompts/monthly_run.md).
Conclusion first: The 8-K has arrived. On 2026-10-24 SpaceX signed a binding commitment letter for a master finance lease of about $40 billion with an entity managed by Apollo, and disclosed it on 10/26 under Item 8.01. The structure is not 'debt' but a GPU lease — the lessor buys Nvidia Vera Rubin GPUs and equipment and leases them to SpaceX, which pays in advance each quarter (1/20 of cost + fixed-rate interest). Each tranche runs about 5 to 5.25 years, the lease commences in the first half of 2027, and closing is expected before year-end. The fixed rate is not yet set (priced before the master lease is signed) — of the four things T5 asked about (rate, collateral, maturity, equity issuance): maturity confirmed · no equity issuance · collateral is the equipment itself given the lease structure (no separate collateral mentioned) · rate not yet set. Probabilities, milestone judgments and fair value are unchanged (no rule triggered; the D-2027-1 judgment year has not arrived). Three things changed — ① we added accounting year = lease commencement year to the definition of 'additional financing' (this $40 billion is counted as 2027 financing); ② we reread proposed new rule ② as 'lease fixed rate' instead of 'bond rate', and recorded that the premise of proposal ③ ('off-balance-sheet SPV') conflicts with the company's wording ('finance lease'); ③ we closed T5 as 'terms disclosure confirmed' and re-set the remaining checkpoint (fixed rate, closing 8-K) to 2027-01-07 (Source: sections 1–3 below).

판정: T5 의 질문 네 가지 중 세 가지가 공시로 닫혔다(만기 5~5.25년 · 증자 요소 없음 · 담보 구조는 리스). 금리만 미정이며, 이는 마스터 리스 체결(연말 전 예정) 때 정해진다. 규칙 신설 제안 ②(금리 8% 초과 확정 시 약세 +5)는 심의 대기 유지 — 심의 대상은 보도 수치가 아니라 체결 8-K 또는 10-K 주석의 고정금리다 (출처: 1절 표 · state.rule_proposals_not_applied).

직전 회차 보도 vs 원문의 차이(기록): ① Bloomberg 10/23 '사모 채권 3트랜치(후순위 $250~300억 등)' — 원문은 리스 스케줄 트랜치(인도 단위)이며 채권 트랜치 구분은 없다. ② 'SPV 부외 구조' — 임대인이 Apollo 운용 법인인 점은 같지만, 회사는 '금융리스'로 부른다(회계 추정은 위 표). ③ CEO 10/25 "종결(closed)" — 원문은 확약서 체결이고 종결은 연말 전 예정. "GPU 2027 1·2분기 도착"은 원문 '2027 상반기 개시'와 부합. 경영진 발언은 여전히 판정 근거가 아니다 (출처: 1절 표 · 직전 회차 보고서 1절).

sections.title: 3 Definitions, Rules, Triggers
sections.html:
3-1. Definition supplement — definitions.additional_financing

The previous round included off-balance-sheet vehicles in 'additional financing' but did not state which year they are counted in. Supplement in this round (source: state.definitions.additional_financing, 2026-10-27):

  • Year of recognition = the year the lease schedule commences (funds are disbursed). It is not the year of commitment or closing. This $40 billion is scheduled to commence in 2027-1H, so it counts toward 2027 financing (commitment stage, before closing and commencement, hence 'scheduled') (source: 8-K 2026-10-26 'lease schedule commences in the first half of 2027', Section 1 table, 'Schedule' row).
  • Arithmetic for D-2027-1 ("2027 additional financing of $50 billion or less AND no equity issuance"): $40 billion ≤ $50 billion → remaining headroom $10 billion (formula: 500 − 400). If other financing in 2027 exceeds $10 billion, the condition is missed. The 8-K contains no equity issuance element.
  • No ruling has been made: the ruling year (2027) has not arrived and the lease has not closed. Status stays Undetermined, and the commitment value is recorded in progress as 'scheduled'.
3-2. Proposed new rules ② and ③ (still not applied)
  • Proposal ② "Confirmed issuance of bonds with a financing rate above 8% (8-K) → bearish +5": the financing is a lease, not a bond. The condition is read as "master finance lease fixed rate above 8% confirmed (execution 8-K or 10-K lease note)". Rate not yet set → deliberation on hold (source: Section 1).
  • Proposal ③ "Off-balance-sheet vehicle confirmed as consolidated debt in the 10-K → bearish +5": the premise ('off-balance-sheet design') conflicts with the company's wording ('finance lease'). If recognizing a lease liability at commencement is the default under accounting principles, the event of 'the off-balance-sheet treatment collapsing' does not occur — the proposal is kept but a weakened premise is recorded, and whether to discard it will be decided by looking at the recognition method in the first 10-Q after commencement (2027-2Q or 3Q report) (source: Section 1, accounting treatment row).
3-3. Triggers — expected vs. actual, forecasting method revision
TriggerPrevious round's expectationActualRulingForecasting method revision
T5 $40 billion 8-K2026-10-31 ~ 11-06 (the 10/26 round narrowed it — "after the 8-K 4-business-day deadline passes"); before that, the 10/23 round said 10/26~11/068-K 2026-10-26 (US) — commitment signed (10/24, Sat), the next business day, Item 8.01 voluntary disclosureWrong (10/26 round) — the 10/23 round's window (10/26~11/06) was right, and the 10/26 round's narrowing to 'after the 2.03 deadline passes' was wrong. Two wrong premises: ① 'If the SPV is off-balance-sheet, an 8-K may not be required' → the company filed under 8.01 immediately, regardless of obligation ② 'CEO's closing announcement = signing date' → it was a commitment, not a closing① The checkpoint is 'expected date + 1 day (KST)' — the KST morning round looks only up to the previous US business day (why the 10/26 KST morning round did not see the 10/26 US filing). ② Primary detection is not by date but by measurement-layer event detection (this round opened that way). ③ Do not infer 'it may not be filed' from the presence or absence of a disclosure obligation — always keep voluntary disclosure channels (8.01, IR press releases) in the verification path

(source: previous value of state.triggers_next_12m · Section 1 above · EDGAR list, accessed 2026-10-27)

T5 follow-up (remaining checkpoint): "Master finance lease signing and fixed rate confirmation" — expected 2027-01-07 (estimate: 8-K 'closing before year-end' + execution 8-K Item 1.01 4 business days + KST 1 day). Verification: ① EDGAR 8-K Item 1.01/2.03·Ex.10 — fixed rate, number of tranches, early termination (call), purchase option ② If before closing, the 4Q26 10-K (estimated 2027-02) lease and commitments note ③ Measurement-layer 'financing' event detection is primary. If there is no execution 8-K by 12/31, record it as a closing delay and defer the deliberation on Proposal ② to the 10-K.
